Title: Updates to .NET implementation support in latest Azure IoT C# SDK release

Body.Content:
The latest release of Azure IoT C# SDK, version 1.20.0, includes two notable updates to .NET implementation support:

  • We added support for .NET Framework 4.7.2.
  • We removed support for .NET Standard 1.3.

.NET Standard 1.3 remains compatible with previous release versions, and it’s still supported in the current long-term support release.  

Learn more or provide feedback on Github.
